edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mint recipient inside mintAlto.
msg.sender receives ETH via transfer in withdrawAlto, enabling value extraction.
msg.sender is compared against proxy registry operator in isApprovedForAll.
block.timestamp initializes safPriceTimestamp in the constructor.
block.timestamp drives the safPrice refresh window in mintAlto (timestamp dependency).
block.timestamp is part of the pseudo-random seed in random().
numberOfNfts participates in price and supply arithmetic inside mintAlto.
_amount is added to maxSupply in increaseMaxSupply.
_dist controls the giveaway loop bound in Giveaway.
_step is assigned to priceStep in updatePriceStep.
timeInSeconds is assigned to safPriceLifetime in changeTimer.
provenanceHash is assigned to ALTO_PROVENANCE in setProvenanceHash.
baseURI is written via _setBaseURI in setBaseURI.
maxSupply is read for supply checks in mintAlto.
maxSupply is incremented in increaseMaxSupply.
maxSupply bounds the giveaway loop in Giveaway.
safPrice is read for the minimum payment check in mintAlto.
getSafPrice returns safPrice.
priceStep is used to recompute safPrice in mintAlto.
priceStep is multiplied in getPrice.
updatePriceStep writes priceStep.
saleIsActive gates minting in mintAlto.
flipSaleState toggles saleIsActive.
safPriceLifetime bounds the price refresh window in mintAlto.
changeTimer writes safPriceLifetime.
mintAlto updates safPriceTimestamp after refreshing the price.
mintAlto reads safPriceTimestamp to evaluate the refresh window.
mintAlto updates safPrice when the lifetime elapsed.
proxyRegistryAddress is queried in isApprovedForAll.
setProvenanceHash writes ALTO_PROVENANCE.
mintAlto calls the unsafe _safeMint minting operation.
Giveaway calls the unsafe _safeMint minting operation.
withdrawAlto performs external ETH transfers to untrusted addresses.
withdrawAlto calls backToCommunity to compute the recipient.
backToCommunity calls random for the token index.
backToCommunity calls ownerOf to resolve the recipient address.
The mint operation invokes ERC721._safeMint.
The giveaway mint operation invokes ERC721._safeMint.
_safeMint triggers _checkOnERC721Received which calls back into the recipient.
_checkOnERC721Received forwards _msgSender() to the recipient callback.
mintIndex is passed as the token id to the _safeMint operation.
share determines the ETH amounts moved by the withdrawal transfers.
index is passed to ownerOf to select the community recipient.

normalization_plan.reason: _amount exists only as the input used to mutate maxSupply inside increaseMaxSupply.
_dist only bounds the mint loop of the Giveaway function.
_step is only used to assign priceStep within updatePriceStep.
timeInSeconds is only validated and assigned to safPriceLifetime inside changeTimer.
numberOfNfts is only used for the supply and price checks and loop bound in mintAlto.
provenanceHash is only stored into ALTO_PROVENANCE inside setProvenanceHash.
baseURI is only forwarded to _setBaseURI inside setBaseURI.
mintIndex is a transient token id passed straight into the _safeMint minting operation.
share is the transient amount split across the ETH transfers in withdrawAlto.
index is a transient random modulo totalSupply used only to pick the community recipient.
